csv_project_name: Design for Cypress Parkway Sidewalk Project
csv_agency: Osceola County Board of County Commissioners
csv_scope_of_work: Request for Proposals for Professional Services (PS) to engage a qualified professional engineering consultant to provide engineering services for pedestrian and sidewalk improvements along Cypress Parkway between Doverplum Avenue and Old Pleasant Hill Road in Osceola County. The project supports the County s ADA Transition Plan and includes approximately 1,800 linear feet of new sidewalk and related accessibility upgrades. Work includes ADA curb ramps, pedestrian refuge areas, detectable warnings, and signal improvements. The Consultant shall provide project management, surveying, and coordination with utilities and applicable agencies, including CFX. Additional services include drainage evaluation, environmental screening, and roadway design support. The Consultant will prepare signed and sealed construction plans, specifications, and cost estimates. Deliverables shall be suitable for bidding and construction in accordance with applicable requirements.
